name: Alexander von Humboldt Foundation: Humboldt Research Fellowship for Experienced Researchers
summary: Highly-qualified international scientists and scholars from all disciplines who completed their doctorates less than 12 years ago and wish to spend extended periods of research in Germany are invited to apply. Candidates can come from any
